text:
maria: heads-up — deploy failing with AccessDenied from KMS during decrypt when cross-account lambda assumes role to read envelopes.

josh: error snippet?

maria: `ClientError: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::111222333:assumed-role/team-lambda/SESSION is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999888777:key/abcd` 

lisa: are you assuming with a session policy or max_session_duration override?

maria: using `sts:AssumeRole` via our infra; role has `sts:ExternalId` and `MaxSessionDuration` 3600. No session policy set intentionally.

josh: two common gotchas: 1) the KMS key policy denies `kms:Decrypt` unless principal is in key policy or a grant exists. 2) session policy can drop kms permissions.

maria: key policy does allow `arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/team-lambda` and `arn:aws:iam::111222333:root` — but assume role principal shows as `arn:aws:sts::111222333:assumed-role/team-lambda/SESSION` which should match.

lisa: can you paste the key policy snippet?

maria: ```json
{
  "Sid": "AllowLambdaRole",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/team-lambda"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

andy: note that KMS evaluates the principal ARN after assume-role — the key policy needs to include the assumed-role principal or a wildcard for `arn:aws:sts::*:assumed-role/team-lambda/*`.

josh: also check whether a Grant was created earlier that got revoked by key rotation. Grants are per-key and can reference grant tokens when created. If client used a grant token and key rotated, decrypts can fail.

maria: we do envelope rotation daily but thought we had proper grants. audit shows `Decrypt` calls from the lambda but KMS returns AccessDenied. No Grant-related logs.

lisa: run `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id abcd` and also check CloudTrail for `CreateGrant`/`RevokeGrant` events around rotation time.

maria: running those now, will post snippets. quick question: could STS session tags or session-policy affect `kms:EncryptionContext` requirement? We're not setting encryption context explicitly.

andy: EncryptionContext only matters if the key policy or IAM condition requires `kms:EncryptionContext:...`. Check key policy conditions for `kms:EncryptionContext:...` and `aws:PrincipalTag`.

maria: found it — a condition in key policy: "kms:EncryptionContext:environment": "prod".

josh: aha. when lambda assumed role via federation the session didn't include that context. Decrypt fails if context required but not provided. Two fixes: remove Mandatory EncryptionContext condition or ensure caller passes the encryption context when decrypting (or use grants that bypass the constraint).

maria: thanks. for short-term fix, we can add a grant to allow the assumed-role ARN to call `kms:Decrypt` without requiring context.

lisa: note that grants are subject to grant tokens when used in the same request. For cross-account/assume flows, better to update key policy to include `arn:aws:sts::111222333:assumed-role/team-lambda/*` as principal.

josh: also verify that `MaxSessionDuration` isn't causing session to be truncated and lose tags that are used in policy conditions.

maria: will update policy and create a grant, test, and report back.

kms-audit-bot: detected policy change (redacted) on key abcd by maria at 2024-05-14T18:33:21Z :warning: 

maria: tests passed — decrypt succeeds after adding assumed-role principal and temporarily relaxing EncryptionContext condition. will schedule smaller-migration to reintroduce context with code changes.

lisa: file a short postmortem with steps and ACL diff. tag sec-compliance.

maria: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
